order: discover all valid attempts across every input root
select one deterministic latest attempt per task_id
include only latest attempts whose verifier reward is numeric 0 or 1
selection_policy.latest_key: nearest batch directory timestamp YYYY-MM-DD__HH-MM-SS, then result.started_at, result.finished_at, and absolute result path
selection_policy.no_verified_fallback: If the latest attempt has no numeric reward, the task is excluded; an older verified attempt is never substituted.

timeout_definition.timeout_observed: Explicit LLM fallback timeout, product timeout, verifier timeout, or Harbor adapter timeout evidence.
timeout_definition.controller_deadline_suspected: Inference only: retry report is still running/incomplete and agent duration reached at least 95% of the configured product deadline.
timeout_definition.compatibility_alias: The trial-level timeout field and summary timeout/non_timeout groups currently use timeout_or_deadline_suspected; use timeout_observed when only literal timeout evidence is acceptable.

token_definition.source_kind: Provider-reported usage persisted by Astra; no local tokenizer is used.
token_definition.canonical_priority: When a selected session is retained in MatrixOne astra_runtime.agent_events with event_type=llm_response, its aggregate is canonical. Otherwise the local session artifacts below are used.
token_definition.total_formula: token_total = token_input + token_output; cache is a subset of input and is never added twice
token_definition.session_input: Local fallback: sum deduplicated server-events.jsonl context_trace_signal metadata.budget.total_used values across the selected Astra session, including resumed outer retries.
token_definition.detail_reconstruction: Use final astra.stdout.json plus pipeline_feedback events timestamped before the final successful retry; without successful stdout, use all returned pipeline_feedback usage.
token_definition.harbor_role: result.json n_input/n_cache/n_output is a terminal-attempt cross-check only, not the canonical session-wide retry total.
token_definition.missing_rule: Missing usage remains null, never zero. token_total is null unless both canonical input and reconciled output are available.
token_definition.known_minimum: token_known_minimum is the sum of components actually observed; an in-flight request that never returned usage can be absent.
token_definition.billing_caveat: Observed telemetry is not a provider invoice. No USD estimate is made without reliable billing and model pricing data.

resource_metric_availability.time: available as task/phase durations; sums are task-seconds, not batch wall-clock
resource_metric_availability.provider_reported_tokens: available with per-field coverage in metrics_by_group
resource_metric_availability.tool_calls: available from local step-event ledgers with telemetry status and terminal coverage

limitations: Verifier reward is the inclusion and pass/no-pass authority. CTRF is independent diagnostic detail and may be missing.
timeout is orthogonal to verifier outcome: recovered request timeouts and deadline termination can still leave passing artifacts.

controller_deadline_suspected is explicitly an inference, requiring an incomplete running retry report and observed agent duration near the configured deadline; it is not presented as a literal timeout log event.
Cumulative LLM and tool-call latency can overlap and must not be added to phase wall times as a resource decomposition.
CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, network bytes, and actual provider billing are absent and intentionally not estimated.
